catalogs.purpose: Single-page executive command dashboard for NIRIKSHAN, a Government of Maharashtra PWD project-monitoring and accountability platform. It gives a chief-engineer-level officer (Shri R. K. Verma, IAS) one screen for: state-wide KPIs, portfolio health, statutory execution-stage pipeline, an urgent officer action queue (SLA-breach items), a filterable active-projects register, AI advisories, and ground-truth visual evidence (drone/GIS/lab). Built with Tailwind CDN + a Material-3-style token config (Noto Sans, Material Symbols), fixed header + fixed left sidebar layout.

catalogs.purpose: The Budget & Finance ("Financial Accountability & Public Fund Tracking") screen of the NIRIKSHAN government project-monitoring platform. It gives a Chief Engineer / Project Director a treasury-linked single view of the state PWD's fund flow for FY 2025-26: top-level allocation/LoC/disbursement KPIs, a physical-vs-financial burn health check with early-warning enforcement, a statutory pipeline of contractor Running Account (RA) bills with e-MB and lab-QA clearance stages, scheme-wise allocation vs utilization bars, and a statutory audit-trail footer tying the page to BeAMS/PFMS gateways.

catalogs.purpose: A tender-bid evaluation screen for the NIRIKSHAN (Nirikshan) government project-monitoring platform. For tender TNT-PWD-MH-2026-0048 (Nagpur-Wardha High-Speed Connecting Flyover), it presents an AI-assisted comparative risk/capability analysis of 4 shortlisted bidders, an explainable-AI (XAI) factor breakdown of the recommended L1 bidder (Sahyadri Infra Projects), statutory transparency disclaimers, transparent risk/caution flags, and a committee action panel with officer sign-off and digital audit trail. It is the active page under the "Tender & Procurement" section of the platform shell (fixed header + fixed sidebar).
